'''Popped chorus fruit''' is the simple preparation of [[chorus fruit]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants {{EffectLink|Levitation}} III for 3 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/popped_chorus_fruit.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Chorus fruit pops only in an [[oven]] (5 seconds); there is no kindling recipe. The chorus fruit unlock advancement grants the ID <code>food/oven/popped_chorus_fruit</code>, but the recipe is stored as <code>food/crafting/popped_chorus_fruit</code>, so it never appears in the recipe book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/chorus_fruit.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating popped chorus fruit takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Levitation III for 0:03.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/popped_chorus_fruit.json}}</ref> Unlike raw chorus fruit it doesn't teleport.

Popped chorus fruit is used in [[chorus mochi]] and, as in vanilla, purpur blocks.
